high_level_description: The image depicts a research station named "Maitri 2" located in East Antarctica. The text at the top of the image states, "India to build new research station 'Maitri 2' in East Antarctica by January 2029." The setting is a remote, icy landscape typical of Antarctica, with snow-covered ground and rocky outcrops. The research station itself is modern and well-constructed, featuring a large, white, dome-shaped structure that appears to be a significant part of the facility. This dome could house scientific instruments or serve as a protective enclosure for sensitive equipment.
